receipt_status_note: commit_sha, parent_sha and path_sha256 are null by construction. The Coordinator session that authored this batch's ledger content had NO shell and NO Git access and attempted no Git operation. These fields are filled only by the orchestrator after the isolated commit, and the dispatcher binds them to Git. Nothing in this batch is official until that post-commit verification passes.

declared_source_paths_that_do_not_exist.reason: TASK-20260727-007 and TASK-20260727-008 were cancelled unexecuted and produced nothing. They remain declared sources of this archive because tools/research_dispatch.py requires every non-archive task to be assigned exactly once and _validate_review_chains requires the ledger archive of the claim-relevant producer TASK-20260727-005 to claim and depend on every one of its independent reviews; removing them fails queue validation. Consequence: this archive's expected-path set is a strict superset of what can be committed, so the completed-archive path_sha256 check cannot cover these four paths. The filled receipt must record the paths ACTUALLY committed and cite goal integrity note INT-BATCH006-016 and queue integrity note AMEND-2026-07-27-J. No hash may be fabricated for a path that does not exist.
